decisions.reason: As a flagship 2018 launch shown on the home page and tied to the firm's stated direction, it carries high public commitment and sunk investment, so management is likely to continue it absent clear evidence of failure.
This LED luminaire line is close to the core business and likely uses existing design, engineering, retail, and installer assets, which makes management inclined to retain it in a growing market.

The home automation server box fits the firm's wider interior-lighting-and-control offer, but because it was less visibly committed than the flagship products and is somewhat more adjacent to the core, it has the highest risk of being discontinued.
A luminaire family with its own page represents a visible commitment within the firm's established premium lighting range, so escalation of commitment and strategic fit both favor keeping it.
